title: Small Parts Laminator III
html:
Small Parts Laminator III

This equipment is part of Accudyne Systems’ Automation-Assisted Work Cell portfolio and incorporates Automatic Tool Positioning; Pick-and-Place; Integrated Work-Order and Recipe Management; and Manufacturing Information System Integration.

Other Details:

  • Lamination of constant cross-section parts from pre-preg fabric
  • Builds parts from recipes, one ply at a time
  • Operator places ply on machine table base
  • Machine picks, places and forms ply on tool
  • Compaction of every ply
  • Builds two parts simultaneously at a rate of 1 ply/minute
  • Male or female tools at 0/90 or 45 degree
